reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004B0B90 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/sys/004B0B90-Sys_ReadFileBlock_2.cpp at sha256 b4f2d06a8ebe617baa050c25462d628e929c2fdf61aeb4e704f3f58567e4b911 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t Sys_ReadFileBlock_2(void);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Sys_ReadFileBlock_2
retail_function.summary: Five-byte compiler jump thunk 0x004B0B90: `jmp AnimSound_LoadParameters` to 0x4C1780; one block, no edges, no locals, no constants.

candidate_function.summary: The candidate defines `j_AnimSound_LoadParameters()` with the body `return AnimSound_LoadParameters();`, a single tail call to AnimSound_LoadParameters.

candidate_comparison.statement: No candidate divergence found in the checked dimensions.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004B0B90 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/sys/004B0B90-Sys_ReadFileBlock_2.cpp (sha256 b4f2d06a8ebe617baa050c25462d628e929c2fdf61aeb4e704f3f58567e4b911). Five-byte compiler jump thunk 0x004B0B90: `jmp AnimSound_LoadParameters` to 0x4C1780; one block, no edges, no locals, no constants. Candidate: The candidate defines `j_AnimSound_LoadParameters()` with the body `return AnimSound_LoadParameters();`, a single tail call to AnimSound_LoadParameters.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN models 0x004B0B90 as `int32_t()`/`uint32_t()` (no arguments, 32-bit result) and the candidate's `j_AnimSound_LoadParameters()` has the same no-argument ABI; the header declares the catalog prototype Sys_ReadFileBlock_2(void).

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: No arguments; the tail call forwards the caller's stack and registers unchanged, exactly like the retail jmp.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 1 blocks / 0 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 1 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail's single instruction is the jump to AnimSound_LoadParameters (0x4C1780); the candidate's single statement is a tail call to AnimSound_LoadParameters at the same address (BN callee table).

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: No stack locals and no global writes in either.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: The jmp forwards AnimSound_LoadParameters's 32-bit return value unchanged; `return AnimSound_LoadParameters();` returns the same register.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t()" at 0x004B0B90; radare2 recovers "fcn.004b0b90 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004B0B90 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t Sys_ReadFileBlock_2(void);.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The catalog name Sys_ReadFileBlock_2 is a harvest label: the retail bytes at 0x004B0B90 are a compiler jump thunk to AnimSound_LoadParameters (0x4C1780), not an implementation of Sys_ReadFileBlock_2.

The candidate file defines `j_AnimSound_LoadParameters` while its header declares Sys_ReadFileBlock_2; the header also does not declare AnimSound_LoadParameters. The definition/header names disagree even though the address-bound body matches retail.
The body is a source-level tail call; whether the compiler emits a jmp or a call+ret for it is a build-time question outside this structural review.
